_meta.title: West Bank movement obstacles (OCHA, 2022): checkpoints, road gates, roadblocks and earth mounds
_meta.what: Points where Israeli authorities restrict Palestinian movement in the West Bank: staffed checkpoints, road gates, partial checkpoints, roadblocks and earth mounds, as mapped by UN OCHA.
_meta.source: UN OCHA occupied Palestinian territory, "State of Palestine - Humanitarian Access" dataset, Closures_2022.gdb
_meta.licence: CC BY (Creative Commons Attribution International), as stated on HDX
_meta.citation: OCHA oPt, Closures 2022, Humanitarian Data Exchange, CC BY
_meta.notes: All points from the three point layers kept with every field as published. Coordinates reprojected from UTM 36N (EPSG:32636) to WGS84. "hide_h2" is a field in the source (likely whether to hide in the Hebron H2 map view). Checkpoint_type, Operated_by and Governorates are numeric codes; the geodatabase holds no code list (its Domains element is empty) and HDX gives none, so the codes are kept as published and not translated.
